scope: Actual Studio components with synthetic records and RPC adapters. This does not establish authenticated QA, Storage, provider, publishing-worker or physical-device acceptance.

checks.name: Professional shell uses a dedicated rail with a real return to the public app
Tool search focuses, filters actual destinations and restores focus on Escape
Overview publishing queue opens the exact draft and failed-upload destination
Campaign filtering cannot leave an actionable hidden campaign selected
Campaign creation validates the budget and saves a draft after a review step
Advertising review keeps submission blocked until creative is present
Failed ad-picker loading is shown with retry and retains the current campaign
Insights separates organic and paid reports and exposes exact daily chart values
A failed Insights period change retains and labels the last confirmed report
Planner deep link opens the intended draft and guards Cancel against unsaved changes
Newsroom reads the linked draft before review and requires feedback for requested changes
Ambiguous workflow submission preserves one exact request and safely retries it
Scheduling requires a separate confirmation with the approved publication time
Business deliverable approval does not grant either creator permission
Switching to the named creator exposes permission controls with expiry and explicit consent
A changed source invalidates displayed consent and still allows revoking the recorded grant
Creator permission can be revoked without accidentally granting paid promotion
Earnings preserves provider restrictions and does not turn absent balances into invented totals
Creator routes remain available and business-only tools have an intentional return path
Team navigation opens real organization members and links to protected business codes
Member creation binds the submitted identity and uses least privilege by default
Dark Studio inherits readable surfaces while retaining professional navigation
Studio fits a 390-pixel viewport without horizontal page overflow
Mobile navigation opens, traps focus, closes on Escape and restores its trigger
Mobile assignment creation preserves text when closing is cancelled
